# Couple Money Tracker — App Spec & Build Plan

Oct 16, 2026 · @Martino Cornelius

## Overview

Couple Money Tracker (working name) is a shared money log for couples and their families: every member joins one home with a home code or invite link, with no accounts or passwords, and logs income and expenses into shared pockets. Everyone sees each entry within seconds, along with upcoming payables and receivables. It runs in any browser, so there is no app to install.

- **Who it's for:** couples, and the family members they invite, who share household money and want to see spending as it happens, not at the end of the month.
- **Main goal:** logging a transaction takes under 10 seconds, so both partners actually do it every day.
- **MVP success:** every member uses it daily for 2 weeks without falling back to notes or spreadsheets.
- **Currency:** Indonesian Rupiah, shown as Rp 25.000 (whole rupiah, no decimals).
- **Interface language:** English for the MVP. Open question: add Bahasa Indonesia later?

## MVP scope

The first version does seven things and nothing else, in the phone or laptop browser.

1. **Create or join a home, no passwords:** one person creates a home and shares an invite link or the 12-character home code. Anyone who opens the link or enters the code types their name and is in. Each browser remembers its home, so there is nothing to log into next time. Every member can log income and expenses.
2. **Pockets:** the places your money sits, such as a bank account, cash or an e-wallet. A bank account pocket requires a bank name and account number (rekening); other types never ask for one. Each pocket shows its current balance.
3. **Add a transaction fast:** income or expense, amount, pocket, category, optional note, date (defaults to now).
4. **Shared live feed:** every member's transactions in one list, each labeled with who logged it, plus today's and this month's income, expense and balance. New entries appear on every open phone within about 5 seconds, without refreshing.
5. **Payables and receivables:** record money the family owes (payable, hutang) and money owed to the family (receivable, piutang) with the counterparty, amount and expected payment date. Overdue and due-soon items stand out. Marking one paid records the matching transaction in a pocket.
6. **Monthly budgets per category:** any member can set a monthly spending limit for an expense category, such as Food and drinks Rp 3.000.000. A budget is optional and repeats every month. Home shows how much of each budget this month's expenses have used: amber from 80%, red when over.
7. **Monthly summary and insights:** pick a month to see its income, expense and savings, spending by category as a bar chart, a comparison with the month before, and up to four plain-language insights such as "Food and drinks: 18% more than last month". The app works the insights out with fixed rules (see Monthly insights below); no AI or outside service is involved.

**Later list** (not in the MVP):

- Optional PIN lock on each device
- Instant updates without the 5-second check
- Transfers between pockets (e.g. ATM withdrawal from a bank pocket to cash)
- Partial payments on payables and receivables
- Reminders before an expected payment date
- Push notifications when a member logs something
- Charts and reports beyond the monthly summary (e.g. yearly trends)
- Recurring transactions (rent, subscriptions)
- Receipt photos
- Export to Excel or CSV
- Private entries (for gift surprises)
- Custom categories
- Bahasa Indonesia interface
- Bank account syncing

## Screens

The MVP has ten screens, all designed phone-first (375 px wide). A bottom tab bar links Home, Pockets, Payables & receivables and Settings, with a + button for new entries.

| #   | Screen                           | What it shows                                                                                                                                                                                               | What you can do                                                                                                             |
| --- | -------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| 1   | Welcome                          | Shown when this browser hasn't joined a home yet                                                                                                                                                            | Create a new home (home name + your name) or enter a home code                                                              |
| 2   | Join (from an invite link)       | The home's name and its existing members                                                                                                                                                                    | Pick your name if you joined before on another device, or type a new name; tap Join                                         |
| 3   | Home (shared feed)               | This month's income, expense and balance; total across all pockets; payables and receivables due in the next 7 days; this month's budgets (spent vs. limit per category); transaction list with amount, pocket, category, note, who logged it and time           | Switch between Today and This month; filter by pocket; tap + to add; tap your own entry to edit                             |
| 4   | Add / edit transaction           | Expense or Income toggle (Expense by default), large amount field, pocket picker (remembers your last pocket), category grid, note, date and time                                                           | Save; edit or delete your own entries only                                                                                  |
| 5   | Pockets                          | Every pocket with its type and current balance; bank pockets also show the bank name and a masked account number (•••• 1234)                                                                                | Add a pocket; open one to see its transactions; reveal or copy an account number                                            |
| 6   | Add / edit pocket                | Name, type (Bank account, Cash, E-wallet, Other), opening balance; bank name and account number fields appear only when the type is Bank account                                                            | Save; archive a pocket you no longer use                                                                                    |
| 7   | Payables & receivables           | Two tabs: Payables (the family owes) and Receivables (owed to the family); each item's counterparty, amount and expected payment date; overdue items in red, due within 7 days in amber; open total per tab | Add an item; mark one as paid; switch between Open and Paid                                                                 |
| 8   | Add / edit payable or receivable | Payable or Receivable toggle, counterparty, amount, expected payment date, note                                                                                                                             | Save; when marking paid, pick a pocket and date, and the matching transaction is recorded                                   |
| 9   | Home settings                    | Home name, members, home code, invite link and monthly budget per expense category                                                                                                                                                               | Copy or share the invite link (WhatsApp-friendly text); reset the home code; remove a member; set, change or clear a category's monthly budget; leave the home on this device |
| 10  | Monthly summary                  | One month's income, expense and savings (income − expense, and as % of income); spending by category as a bar chart, largest first; change vs. the month before; budget results; up to four insights | Pick the month (previous / next); open it from a "See monthly summary" link on Home |

**Default categories** (fixed list in the MVP):

- Expense: Food and drinks, Groceries, Transport, Bills and utilities, Shopping, Health, Entertainment, Gifts, Debt payment, Other
- Income: Salary, Bonus, Side income, Debt received, Other

**Monthly insights** (screen 10). The app checks these rules in this order and shows the first four that apply. Months run from the 1st to the last day; amounts are whole rupiah.

1. **Savings:** if income is more than expense, "You saved X% of your income" (rounded to a whole percent). If expense is more than income, "You spent Rp X more than you earned".
2. **Over budget:** for each category over its budget, "Entertainment went over budget by Rp X".
3. **Biggest increase:** the expense category that grew most compared with the month before, if it grew by at least 20% and at least Rp 100.000: "Food and drinks: X% more than last month".
4. **Biggest decrease:** the category that shrank most, by the same thresholds: "Transport: X% less than last month".
5. **Top category:** "Groceries was X% of your spending".
6. **Largest expense:** "Largest expense: Rp X on Shopping (note, date)".

A month with no transactions shows "No transactions in this month yet" instead of insights. A rule that needs the month before is skipped when that month has no transactions.

invite-link join and live-sync flow · 2 members, 6 steps

You create the home and share the invite link (or read out the home code). Your partner opens it in their phone browser, types a name and is in, with no app or password. Any member who joins can log entries, and every open phone picks up new ones within about 5 seconds.

## Data model

Seven tables in one Cloudflare D1 database hold everything: homes, members, the devices each member uses, pockets, transactions, payables and receivables, and budgets. Every record belongs to one home. The monthly summary and its insights are calculated from transactions and budgets each time; nothing extra is stored. Ids are random text, money is whole rupiah stored as integers, and dates are text in ISO format (2026-10-16T09:30). A pocket's balance is calculated (opening balance + income − expenses in that pocket), never stored.

**homes** — one row per home

| Field      | Type | Notes                                                                                                                    |
| ---------- | ---- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| id         | text | Random id, generated automatically                                                                                       |
| name       | text | e.g. "Our home"                                                                                                          |
| home_code  | text | 12 random characters shown as XXXX-XXXX-XXXX; unique; no look-alikes such as 0/O or 1/I; replaced when someone resets it |
| created_at | text | Set automatically                                                                                                        |

**members** — one row per person in a home

| Field        | Type | Notes                                           |
| ------------ | ---- | ----------------------------------------------- |
| id           | text | Random id                                       |
| home_id      | text | Points to homes                                 |
| display_name | text | e.g. "Andi"; unique within a home               |
| removed_at   | text | Set when the member is removed; empty otherwise |
| created_at   | text | Set automatically                               |

**devices** — each browser a member has joined from

| Field        | Type | Notes                                                                                  |
| ------------ | ---- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| id           | text | Random id                                                                              |
| member_id    | text | Points to members; one member can have several devices                                 |
| token_hash   | text | SHA-256 hash of the device's secret token; the token itself lives only in that browser |
| last_seen_at | text | Updated on each visit                                                                  |
| created_at   | text | Set automatically                                                                      |

**pockets** — where the money sits

| Field           | Type    | Notes                                                                                                                                                |
| --------------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| id              | text    | Random id                                                                                                                                            |
| home_id         | text    | Points to homes                                                                                                                                      |
| name            | text    | e.g. "BCA joint account", "Cash in wallet"                                                                                                           |
| type            | text    | bank, cash, e_wallet or other                                                                                                                        |
| bank_name       | text    | Required when type is bank; empty otherwise                                                                                                          |
| account_number  | text    | Rekening number. Required when type is bank: digits only, 5 to 20 long. Must be empty for every other type. Stored as text so leading zeros are kept |
| opening_balance | integer | Whole rupiah in the pocket when it is added                                                                                                          |
| archived        | integer | 1 = archived (hidden from pickers, history kept), 0 = active                                                                                         |
| created_by      | text    | The member who added it                                                                                                                              |
| created_at      | text    | Set automatically                                                                                                                                    |

The database itself checks the bank rule: a bank pocket without a bank name or account number is rejected, and so is an account number on any other type.

**transactions** — every income or expense

| Field                  | Type    | Notes                                                                             |
| ---------------------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| id                     | text    | Random id                                                                         |
| home_id                | text    | Points to homes                                                                   |
| member_id              | text    | Who logged it; points to members                                                  |
| pocket_id              | text    | Which pocket the money moved in or out of; required; must belong to the same home |
| type                   | text    | income or expense                                                                 |
| amount                 | integer | Whole rupiah, always positive (25000 = Rp 25.000); never a decimal number         |
| category               | text    | One of the default categories                                                     |
| note                   | text    | Optional, up to 140 characters                                                    |
| occurred_at            | text    | When the money moved; defaults to now                                             |
| created_at, updated_at | text    | Set automatically                                                                 |

**payables_receivables** — money owed, with expected payment dates

| Field                  | Type    | Notes                                                                         |
| ---------------------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| id                     | text    | Random id                                                                     |
| home_id                | text    | Points to homes                                                               |
| kind                   | text    | payable (the family owes, hutang) or receivable (owed to the family, piutang) |
| counterparty           | text    | Person or company, e.g. "Budi" or "Credit card"                               |
| amount                 | integer | Whole rupiah, always positive                                                 |
| due_date               | text    | Expected payment date, e.g. 2026-11-25                                        |
| status                 | text    | open or paid                                                                  |
| note                   | text    | Optional, up to 140 characters                                                |
| paid_at                | text    | Set when marked paid                                                          |
| transaction_id         | text    | The transaction recorded when it was marked paid                              |
| created_by             | text    | The member who added it                                                       |
| created_at, updated_at | text    | Set automatically                                                             |

Marking an item paid creates one transaction in the chosen pocket: a payable becomes an expense in the "Debt payment" category, and a receivable becomes income in "Debt received".

**budgets** — monthly spending limit per expense category

| Field                  | Type    | Notes                                                                      |
| ---------------------- | ------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| id                     | text    | Random id                                                                  |
| home_id                | text    | Points to homes                                                            |
| category               | text    | One of the default expense categories; one budget per category per home    |
| monthly_limit          | integer | Whole rupiah, always positive; the same limit applies every month          |
| created_by             | text    | The member who set it                                                      |
| created_at, updated_at | text    | Set automatically                                                          |

A category's spending this month is the sum of that home's expenses in the category from the 1st of the month. Clearing a budget deletes its row; transactions are never changed.

## Security rules

With no passwords, two secrets protect a home: the home code decides who may join, and a device token proves a browser already joined. The Cloudflare Worker checks them on every request; the app's screens are never trusted to hide data.

| Action                                              | Who can do it                                                             |
| --------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| See anything in a home                              | Only devices that joined that home                                        |
| Join a home                                         | Anyone with the current home code or invite link                          |
| Add pockets, transactions, payables and receivables | Any member, only inside their own home                                    |
| Edit or delete a transaction                        | Only the member who logged it                                             |
| Edit pockets, payables and receivables              | Any member of the home                                                    |
| Set, change or clear budgets                        | Any member of the home                                                    |
| Reset the home code                                 | Any member; old links and codes stop working, joined devices keep working |
| Remove a member                                     | Any member; that member's devices lose access immediately                 |

- **Home code:** 12 random characters (about 60 bits) made with a secure random generator on the server, so guessing one is not practical.
- **Device token:** 32 random bytes created when a browser joins, kept in that browser's local storage. The database stores only its SHA-256 hash.
- **Every request checked:** every API call except create and join must carry the device token. An unknown token, or one belonging to a removed member, gets a "not joined" error and the app returns to Welcome.
- **Home boundaries:** every query is filtered by the caller's home, and every id the app sends (pocket, transaction, item) is checked to belong to that home.
- **No SQL injection:** all queries use bound parameters (prepared statements), never text glued into SQL.
- **HTTPS:** Cloudflare serves the app over HTTPS only.
- **Preview links share the live database,** so test new features in a separate test home.
- **Trade-off to accept:** anyone with the code, or holding an unlocked phone that has joined, can see the whole home, including account numbers. Share the link only with family, and reset the code if it leaks. A PIN lock is on the later list.
- **Proof test:** a second home made in another browser sees none of the first home's data, and after a reset the old invite link fails.

## Tech stack

Everything runs in your browser and in the cloud, so nothing is installed on your laptop: you only use GitHub, Cloudflare and Claude Code on the web.

| Part            | Choice                                                | Why                                                                             |
| --------------- | ----------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Where you work  | Your web browser only                                 | Nothing to install on the office laptop                                         |
| AI builder      | Claude Code on the web (claude.ai/code)               | Works on your GitHub repository in the cloud and pushes each change to a branch |
| Code storage    | GitHub (private repository)                           | Every change is saved; pull requests let you test before going live             |
| Frontend        | React + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS              | AI writes it reliably; Cloudflare builds it, not your laptop                    |
| Hosting and API | One Cloudflare Worker (static assets + /api)          | One project serves both the app and its data                                    |
| Database        | Cloudflare D1                                         | A SQL database you can create and query in the Cloudflare dashboard             |
| Deploys         | Workers Builds connected to GitHub                    | Merging into main updates the live app; other branches get preview links        |
| Live updates    | The app checks for changes every 5 seconds while open | Simple and reliable, with no extra service                                      |
| Joining         | Home code or invite link + device token               | No accounts or passwords                                                        |

GitHub and Cloudflare have free plans that cover a family app; Claude Code on the web needs a paid Claude plan (Pro or higher). Sources: [Claude Code on the web quickstart](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/web-quickstart), [Workers Builds branch settings](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/ci-cd/builds/build-branches/index.md), [Workers Builds configuration](https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/ci-cd/builds/configuration), [D1 get started](https://developers.cloudflare.com/d1/get-started/).

## MVP done checklist

The MVP is finished when every box below is ticked on two real phones.

- ☐ I can create a home with my name and see its home code and invite link
- ☐ My partner opens the invite link on their phone, types a name and is in, with no app and no password
- ☐ Another family member can join by typing the home code
- ☐ The same person can join from a second device by picking their existing name
- ☐ Reopening the browser later goes straight to the home, with nothing to log into
- ☐ Every member can add income and expenses
- ☐ A bank pocket can't be saved without a bank name and account number; a cash or e-wallet pocket never asks for one
- ☐ Account numbers show masked until tapped, and can be copied
- ☐ Each pocket's balance equals its opening balance plus its income minus its expenses
- ☐ I can add an expense in under 10 seconds
- ☐ Other members' open phones show my new entry within about 5 seconds, without refreshing
- ☐ Home shows today's and this month's income, expense and balance, correct to the rupiah
- ☐ Every entry shows who logged it and which pocket it used
- ☐ I can edit or delete my own entries, but not other members'
- ☐ I can add a payable and a receivable with an expected payment date
- ☐ Overdue items show in red, items due within 7 days show in amber, and Home lists what's due in the next 7 days
- ☐ Marking an item paid records the matching expense or income in the chosen pocket
- ☐ I can set a monthly budget for a category, and Home shows spent vs. limit, amber from 80% and red when over
- ☐ The monthly summary shows a month's income, expense, savings and spending by category, correct to the rupiah, with insights that follow the Monthly insights rules
- ☐ After resetting the home code, the old invite link fails but joined phones keep working
- ☐ A removed member's phone loses access immediately
- ☐ A second home made in another browser sees none of our data
- ☐ The app is live on its Cloudflare web address and works in phone browsers on iPhone and Android

## Build plan

You build the app in 10 milestones, entirely in your browser. Every milestone follows the same cycle:

1. Start a new session at claude.ai/code on couple-money and paste the milestone's prompt.
2. When Claude finishes, create a pull request from the session.
3. Open the preview link Cloudflare adds to the pull request (from Milestone 1 on) and run the checks.
4. If everything passes, merge the pull request on GitHub. Cloudflare then updates the live app automatically.

Never start the next milestone before the current one is merged.

### Milestone 0: Accounts (browser only)

- ☐ Check that your office network opens github.com, dash.cloudflare.com and claude.ai/code
- ☐ Create a GitHub account at github.com
- ☐ On GitHub, create a new private repository named couple-money, ticking **Add a README file**
- ☐ Download this doc as Markdown, rename the file SPEC.md, and upload it to the repository (**Add file → Upload files → Commit changes**)
- ☐ Create a free Cloudflare account at dash.cloudflare.com
- ☐ Make sure your Claude plan is Pro or higher
- ☐ Open claude.ai/code, connect GitHub when asked (this installs the Claude GitHub App), and choose couple-money in the repository selector

Check it works: start a session on couple-money and type Read SPEC.md and summarize the app in 5 bullet points. If Claude describes your app, you're ready for Milestone 1. Steps follow the [Claude Code on the web quickstart](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/web-quickstart).

### Milestone 1: Project skeleton and first deploy

Read SPEC.md. It describes the app we are building. I am a complete

on my laptop, so never ask me to run commands. Explain every step in

Check it works: follow Claude's Cloudflare steps, then merge the pull request. Open your app's workers.dev address on your phone: you can tap through all ten screens, and /api/health shows ok.

### Milestone 2: Database

Set up the Cloudflare D1 database from SPEC.md. Write a schema.sql that

Check it works: add a payable due yesterday (red) and a receivable due in 3 days (amber). Mark the payable paid from a bank pocket; a matching expense appears in the feed and that pocket's balance drops by the same amount.

### Milestone 8: Monthly budgets

Build monthly budgets per category from SPEC.md. In Home settings, list

Check it works: set a Food and drinks budget of Rp 100.000, add a Rp 85.000 food expense (the bar turns amber), then another Rp 20.000 (red, over budget). Your partner sees the same budget.

### Milestone 9: Monthly summary and insights

Build the Monthly summary screen from SPEC.md, opened from a "See

### Milestone 10: Polish and home-screen shortcut

Make the app a PWA so it can be added to the phone home screen, with an

## Working with AI coding: rules for beginners

Small steps, frequent save points and exact error messages solve most problems.

1. **One milestone at a time.** Don't start the next one until the current one is merged and its checks pass.
2. **One pull request per milestone.** Merge only after testing the preview link. If a merge breaks the live app, use GitHub's **Revert** button on that pull request.
3. **Report errors exactly.** Say what you did, what you expected and what happened. Take a screenshot (Windows + Shift + S) and paste it into the session.
4. **Stop loops early.** If the same bug survives 3 fixes, ask Claude to explain the cause before changing more code, or revert to the last merged version.
5. **Ask for explanations.** After each change, ask "Explain what you changed in simple words." You'll learn as you build.
6. **Protect secrets.** Never paste your home code, passwords or Cloudflare tokens into code or chat.
7. **Test as two people.** Use a normal window and an incognito window, or your phone, to act as two members.
8. **Keep SPEC.md current.** When you change your mind, edit SPEC.md on GitHub (pencil icon), then tell Claude to re-read it.
